numeric_conversion_proof.behavior: BigUint to_f64 always returns Some, including infinity; BigInt applies its sign. The Number(BigInt) unwrap_or_else branch is not a reachable magnitude-overflow path.

coupling_review.probe_limits: Explicit unchanged-source path plans, not cases or timings. Interfaces/new functions/imports and fixtures can broaden selection. Historical partition observations are not counted as current owning targets.
coupling_review.verification_policy: Prepare all changes/fixtures in each batch first; run related graph partitions; run the final complete inventory once for the final snapshot. No new module is required.
